provenance_rule: A result is authoritative as a reproducible experiment only when an executable runner completes successfully against the locked corpus and emits a result artifact plus a generated provenance manifest containing repository revision, corpus hash, source hashes, runner command, protocol, and result hash.
migration_policy: Do not rewrite or silently replace legacy result artifacts. Reconstruct deterministic runners and emit new reproducible manifests; compare regenerated results with the legacy artifact before upgrading provenance_status.
